candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: All twelve furigana are present and correct, and circled numbers are kept. Stray space in 「ライ ンでは」 in item ③; the padding spaces inside the choice parentheses are dropped.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Body text is accurate and circled numbers are kept. Omits the furigana しゅっせき on 出席 in item ①; all other furigana are correct.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Text and all real furigana are correct. Invents furigana 入院(にゅういん), which is not in the image. Adds a ## heading, which is a reasonable choice.

candidates.label: D
candidates.notes: All text and furigana are correct and nothing is invented. Circled numbers ①–⑤ are converted to a 1.–5. ordered list, a small loss of fidelity to the original markers.

candidates.label: E
candidates.notes: Base text is correct, but furigana is added to nearly every kanji (代, 適切, 選, 入院, 間, 夫, 料理, 工場, 人間, 円, 安, 長, 使 and more) where the image has none. The image annotates only twelve words, so this is heavy fabrication.

rationale: D and A both reproduce all text and exactly the furigana in the image; D has no text errors but changes the circled numbers to a plain list, while A keeps them but has a stray space in ライン, so D edges ahead. B drops one furigana (しゅっせき) and C invents one (にゅういん); I rank the omission above the invention because adding content not in the image is the worse fault. E is last because it fabricates furigana for almost every kanji.
